extension.name: Golden Demo
extension.description: Extracts acceptance criteria from specs, builds test vectors, and produces a behavioral drift report — complementary to Architecture Guard and CDD.
extension.author: jasstt

commands.name: speckit.golden-demo.extract-vectors
commands.description: Reads spec.md and plan.md, identifies acceptance criteria, writes .specify/golden-demo/test-vectors.md

commands.name: speckit.golden-demo.check-drift
commands.description: Reads test-vectors.md and reports which vectors would be executed (dry-run stub)

hooks.prompt: Golden Demo: extract test vectors from spec and plan?
hooks.description: Pulls acceptance-criteria items into .specify/golden-demo/test-vectors.md after planning

hooks.prompt: Golden Demo: run behavioral drift check?
hooks.description: Dry-run drift report against the captured test vectors after implementation
